entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Cold start for RX subscriptions is slower on .net10 #127687
  • [aw] Mobile Platform Failure Scanner failed #127682
  • Static field initialization order bug in LoggingEventSource causes ParseFilterSpec to silently produce wrong rules #127681
    11.0.0
  • System.Management strongly typed WMI generator emits non-disposable wrappers over disposable WMI resources #127678

Closed

  • Test Failure: System.Linq.Tests crashed with SIGSEGV #127671

PullRequests

Created

  • Ensure we preserve vn and produce a canonical tree #127689
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [DRAFT][PROTO] Push constants right more frequently #127688
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Reorder static fields in LoggingEventSource to prevent reentrant bug in FilterSpec parsing #127686
    area-Extensions-Logging, 11.0.0
  • JIT: remove MorphAddrContext #127684
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Move FuncEvalFrame/DebuggerU2MCatchHandlerFrame detection to SfiNextWorker #127683
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr
  • Fix GC reporting of uninitialized local after throw #127680
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix scoped Utf8JsonReader to carry original position #127679
    area-System.Text.Json, community-contribution
  • Hide Environment.CallEntryPoint in unhandled exception message #127677
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr
  • [release/11.0-preview4] Revert "Simplify TrimmerSingleWarn intermediate assembly update using MSBuild item Update" #127676
    linkable-framework, area-Tools-ILLink
  • JIT: Change `IntegralRange` to handle arbitrary int64_t #127675
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution

Merged

  • Update fgMorphSmpOp to canonicalize commutative and compare ops at the start of POST-ORDER #127661
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Don't report a interp->native transition when it is done from a pinvoke method #127660
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • Remove DacDbi GetAppDomainObject API from native and cDAC #127673
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Fix NativeAOT hex config parser to handle `0x`/`0X` prefix #127644
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • JIT: make funclet order correspond to EH clause order #127590
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix NativeAOT GC roots after universal transition #127640
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

Updated

  • [cDAC] implement GetRuntimeNameByAddress #127134
    area-Diagnostics-cdac
  • Delete CreateProcessW impl from PAL #127604
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2965894 #127475
    area-System.Text.Json
  • JIT: Fix GenTree::IsPow2 functions #127615
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add Azure Linux 4 to libraries Helix extra-platforms (linux_x64) #127613
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • JIT: coalesce constant-indexed bounds checks within a block #127439
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: Use `VisitLocalDefNodes` from `gtTreeHasLocalStore` #127555
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [browser][coreclr] WASM-specific GC OS layer; no mmap/decommit #127328
    arch-wasm, area-GC-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Disable server GC and background GC for CoreCLR WebAssembly builds #127178
    arch-wasm, area-GC-coreclr
  • Intrinsify string.FastAllocateString #127659
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [Wasm RyuJIT] Wire up GC info encoding/decoding for Wasm #126932
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Convert funceval to UCO pattern #126809
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add `Separator` property to `XmlTextAttribute` and `XmlAttributeAttribute` for configurable list serialization #126767
    area-Serialization, 11.0.0
  • Support typeof(T).Assembly.GetType(string) in ILLink dataflow analysis #127319
    linkable-framework, area-Tools-ILLink
  • JIT: Clean up and unify SELECT opts #127621
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [WASM] Add READYTORUN_FIXUP_InjectStringThunks and R2R thunk infrastructure #127483
